sloka: काम रूपी हरि श्रेष्ठो बल रूप समन्वितः ।अनिवार्य गतिः चैव यथा सततगः प्रभुः ॥६-२८-११॥।।
transliteration: kāma rūpī hari śreṣṭho bala rūpa samanvitaḥ ।anivārya gatiḥ caiva yathā satatagaḥ prabhuḥ ॥6-28-11॥।।

translations.english: "He is a jewel among Vanaras. He can change his form at his will. He is endowed with physical strength and charm. Being existent everywhere like windgod his cause cannot be prevented like that of wind god."
translations.hindi: हो पेट अष्टावशाः सँग: २४२ सो इसे आप पहिले देख ही चुके हैं, वद्दी फिर आयां है! यह केसरी का श्रेष्ठ पुत्र हे और वातात्मन अथात्‌ वाउउद्र के नाम से प्रतिद्व हे
